entries.german:
Abt Heinrich von St. Gallen beurkundet, dass Rudolf der Schultheiss von Wil seiner Enkelin Adelheid von Zuckenriet einen Zehnten unter Rotmonten, Weinberge zu Berneck, einen Hof zu Oberdorf und die Vogtei Hohfirst zu rechtem Lehen vermacht habe.

In gottis namen amen. Wir von gottis gnadin abt Heinrich zi sante Gallin 1 kvnden allen den, die II disin brief sehint odir iemir ho erint lesin, das Rv odolf der schultheisse von Wile 2 hat gimaIIchot reht vnd a) redilichin mit vnsir hant Adilheit sinir tohtir tohtir, du Heinriches des langin | Lo vwin von Zukinrieht 3 tohtir ist, den zehinden von des Hafiners gůte vndir dem Rodimunt 4 bi sante Gallin vnd den wingartin zi Bernang 5 in dem Rintal, der da heissit Kaechilis wingarte, vnd sinin hof zi Obirndorf 6 vnd die vogteie zi Honuirst 7 vnd sinin wingartin, der da heissit an dem Ranfte 8 vnd lit vndir der burg zi Bernang, zi rehtim lehin, vnd hat der selbun Adilheit ubir du gu etir, du hie gischribin sint, Johansin vnd Rv odolfin sinis brůdirs sune Johansin saelgin des Spisers von sante Gallin zi gitruwen tragern gebin mit vnsir hant. Doch ist der vorginande hof zi Obirndorf vnd du vogteie zi Honuirst vnd der wingarte an dem Ranfte vndir der burg zi Bernang fron Gůtun des vorginandin Rv odolfin des schultheissin wirtinne reht lipdinge, vnd ist das mit vnsir hant reht vnd redilich bischehin, vnd dauon sol si an den selben gůtirn, die wile si lept, niemir biswaerit werdin. Das abir allis, das hie gischribin stat, ganz vnd staete bilibe, so henken wir der vorginande abt Heinrich von sante Gallin vnsir insigil an disin brief zi einim staetin vrkunde. Dis bischah vnd wart dise brief gebin zi sante Gallin, do man zalte von gottis giburte druzehin hundirt jare, darnah in dem sibindin jare, an dem naehstin vritage nah sant Andres tult, da zigegin warin her Egilolf von Rosinberg 9, her Cv onrat von Gru eninstein 10 rittir, V olrich Meldli 11, Lutholt der schenke von Landegge 12, Heinrich vnd Egilolf die Omin von Raetinberg 13, Cv onrat der amman von sante Gallin 14, Gerwig der Peier 15, Johans der Munser von sante Gallin, Heinrich, Egilolf, Cv onrat, Albreht, Jacob vnd Cv onrat die Plarer, Hug, Cristan, Cv onrat vnd Hug die Vo elin, Johans vnd Rv odolf die Spiser, Wilderich, V olrich sin sun, meistir V olrich der arzat 16, Walther der Meier, Johans vnd Cůnrat Arndts vnd andir bidirbe lute ginůge.

Siegel: Siegel fehlt.
entries.english:
Abbot Heinrich of St. Gallen certifies that Rudolf, reeve of Wil, gave his granddaughter Adelheid von Zuckenriet a tithe below Rotmonten, vineyards at Berneck, a farm at Oberndorf, and the bailiwick of Hohfirst as a rightful fief.

In God's name, amen. We, Abbot Heinrich of St. Gallen by God's grace, make known to all who see this document or ever hear it read that Rudolf, reeve of Wil, has lawfully and properly enfeoffed with our consent Adelheid, his granddaughter, daughter of Heinrich Lang von Zuckenriet, with the tithe from Hafiner's property below Rotmonten near St. Gallen; the vineyards at Berneck in the Rhine Valley, including the vineyard called Kaechili's vineyard; his farm at Oberndorf; the bailiwick at Hohfirst; and his vineyard called am Ranft, lying below the castle at Berneck. He has given John and Rudolf, sons of his brother John, the late Spiser of St. Gallen, as trustworthy custodians for Adelheid over the properties written here, with our consent. However, the aforementioned farm at Oberndorf, bailiwick at Hohfirst, and vineyard at am Ranft below the castle at Berneck are the rightful life estate of Frau Guta, wife of the aforementioned Rudolf the reeve. This has been lawfully and properly done with our consent, and while she lives she shall never be disturbed in those same properties. So that all written here may remain whole and firm, we, the aforementioned Abbot Heinrich of St. Gallen, attach our seal to this document as lasting confirmation. This took place and the document was issued at St. Gallen in the year 1307 from the birth of Christ, on the Friday after St. Andrew's feast. Present were Lord Egilolf von Rosenberg; Lord Cunrat of Grünenstein, Ritter; Volrich Meldli; Lutolt the Schenk von Landegg; Heinrich and Egilolf the Omin of Rätenberg; Cunrat, the reeve of St. Gallen; Gerwig the Peier; John the Munser of St. Gallen; Heinrich, Egilolf, Cunrat, Albrecht, Jacob, and Cunrat the Plarer; Hugh, Cristan, Cunrat, and Hugh the Völin; John and Rudolf the Spiser; Wilderich and his son Volrich; Magister Volrich the physician; Walther the Meier; John and Cunrat Arndts; and many other worthy people.

Seal: missing.
